answer: Admission requires 1,000 units of fresh computational work per identity, acting as a vibrant lagoon where each agent must prove its unique origin. The verifier enforces this by scanning the pulse of incoming solutions against a ledger of past results to block duplicate activity. An honest participant completes the base task, but an attacker spawning 1,000 fakes must solve 1,000,000 distinct puzzles, hitting a hard wall of energy consumption. Each agent must sharpen its digital quill to submit a verified proof.
